name: Yakima County, WA
findings: Yakima County has 548 nonprofit organizations. 210 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 162 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Yakima County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Economic development organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 14 economic development organizations here list membership, compared with about 4 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do economic development organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Yakima County list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.3 times the typical level).
